cases.transcript: The coordinator recommends the only non-dominated eligible Opportunity after its material advantage remains across credible ranges and all reserved adversarial research is settled. It labels the Value Hypothesis provisional and offers, but does not start, a separate Wayfinder invocation.

The coordinator says the evidence does not justify a Leading Opportunity, renders an unscored Inconclusive Comparison Report, and asks the developer to stop, extend named gaps, or select a non-dominated Opportunity without reclassifying it as Scout-recommended.
The coordinator assigns weighted scores to tied Opportunities, calls the highest total the winner, and writes a Leading Opportunity Brief despite unresolved decision-changing gaps.
The coordinator treats an unsupported market-size assumption as high-confidence evidence, uses it to pass commercial plausibility, and omits its Evidence Gap.
